patch.summary: Is Rank Prompt worth it? Rank Prompt is an AI SEO and search visibility platform — prompt tracking, AI search optimization (GEO/AEO), and content workflows for marketing teams. Tiered SaaS pricing (2026-08-19 — confirm on rankprompt.com).. Strong when SEO/marketing teams optimizing for AI search surfaces. Weak when GEO/AEO niche — not general-purpose AI writing.
